# Telemetry import cleanup is separate from unfinished metric conversion

Fresh complete six-test-file import cleanup read. The only changed hunks remove TelemetryTestUtils imports; assertion bodies/probes are not converted by this landing. Named current test sections use Glean values for Calendar, UI interaction, address books, Filelink, folder modes and header customization. This does not prove all repository metrics migrated or all reset behavior equivalent. Complete shared Bug 1953420 explicitly says the remaining semi-shared version-pin conversion is not fully working and attaches WIP. That attempted conversion is outside this assigned patch. Review has zero technical inline requests beyond acceptance. Existing assertion wording and module-scope var/const choices are not newly changed. No tests or Glean reporting ran.

Scope: Telemetry test import cleanup scope.
